name: Maria D. Villa Lathrop
office: Palos Verdes Library District, Member, Board of Trustees

items.text: Maria D. Villa Lathrop is an attorney and co-founder of the law firm Lathrop & Villa in Rolling Hills Estates. She previously served as vice president and treasurer of the State Bar Board of Governors. Her campaign says her priorities include bringing oversight and fiscal experience to the board and expanding programs for students. She also plans to apply her fundraising background to support the library.
